outcomes.evidence: New Model routes area rule: src/model.ts owns route selection and adapters, the brain is the only caller, privacy explicit and local-only by default at the API, no route fallback, cloud key only in a private file read by the brain (never env, argv, config, logs or doctor), model.complete is coordinator→brain only, replies bounded. test/model.test.ts proves each clause, including the coordinator → brain → S² join, zero requests to the fake cloud when S² fails, socket denial and refusal of a world-readable key file.

Reviewed AGENTS.md, BACKLOG-RULES.md and maintenance.md against the change: no copied harness tool or generic rule changed; package.json (adapted) gains a project dependency only (@anthropic-ai/sdk 1.1.0, pinned exact, released 2026-10-21). Pre-existing dev advisories in vite through @angular/build are recorded as F-031, not fixed here.
